title: Swell waves reach Keralam coast; inundation likely in low-lying areas by August 19 evening
description: As the swell system continues to interact with the coast and is expected to persist till the end of August 20, wave surges and inundation in low-lying areas of the coastal regions in Keralam, south Tamil Nadu districts, and Lakshadweep islands may occur from the evening hours of August 20
